headline: ASBISc Reports Strong Q3 2026 Earnings Beat
summary: ASBISc shares rose 8% following the release of its third-quarter 2026 earnings, which significantly exceeded market expectations.
why: ASBISc is a major distributor of IT products and solutions in emerging markets, and its financial performance is a key indicator of technology demand in those regions.

impacts.name: ASBISc
impacts.why: Strong earnings results typically drive investor confidence and share price appreciation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The 8% jump in share price is a direct reaction to the company's Q3 earnings results beating analyst expectations.
